heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Agency
tree.text: The term “agency” has the meaning given that term in section 551 of title 5.

tree.heading: Intervention
tree.text: The term “intervention” means a specific service delivered to achieve an impact through a social impact partnership project.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Treasury.

tree.heading: Social impact partnership project
tree.text: The term “social impact partnership project” means a project that finances social services using a social impact partnership model.

tree.heading: Social impact partnership model
tree.text: The term “social impact partnership model” means a method of financing social services in which—

children.text: Federal funds are awarded to a State or local government only if a State or local government achieves certain outcomes agreed on by the State or local government and the Secretary; and
the State or local government coordinates with service providers, investors (if applicable to the project), and (if necessary) an intermediary to identify—
an intervention expected to produce the outcome;
a service provider to deliver the intervention to the target population; and
investors to fund the delivery of the intervention.

tree.heading: State
tree.text: The term “State” means each State of the United States, the District of Columbia, each commonwealth, territory or possession of the United States, and each federally recognized Indian tribe.

sourceCredit: (Aug. 14, 1935, ch. 531, title XX, § 2063, as added Pub. L. 115–123, div. E, title VIII, § 50802(2), Feb. 9, 2018, 132 Stat. 282.)
